and maps each evaluated value to `green`, `yellow`, or `red` according to the defined threshold rules.\n- The displayed aggregate state is the worst evaluated per-item state using `red > yellow > green`.\n- Dashboard refresh recomputes the aggregate state from current latest values without requiring a full page reload.\n- If configuration is empty, all items become inaccessible, all items lack usable latest data, or runtime evaluation cannot proceed, the widget shows a consistent existing-style empty/error/no-data state and does not misreport a healthy state.\n- No new trigger, alerting, or +
+exec php "$phar_path" "$@"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
+cache_dir="${PHPUNIT_CACHE_DIR:-$script_dir/.cache}"
+phpunit_version="${PHPUNIT_VERSION:-9.6.34}"
+phar_path="${PHPUNIT_PHAR:-$cache_dir/phpunit-${phpunit_version}.phar}"
+download_url="${PHPUNIT_PHAR_URL:-https://phar.phpunit.de/phpunit-${phpunit_version}.phar}"
+
+if [[ ! -f "$phar_path" ]]; then
+	mkdir -p "$cache_dir"
+	tmp_path="${phar_path}.tmp"
+
+	curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$tmp_path" "$download_url"
+	chmod 0755 "$tmp_path"
+	mv "$tmp_path" "$phar_path"
+fi
+
+exec php "$phar_path" "$@"

{
  "title": "Add aggregated item health dashboard widget with worst-state thresholds",
  "description": "## Goal\nImplement a new Zabbix dashboard widget type in the web UI that lets a user select one or more supported numeric items, configure one shared threshold model, evaluate each selected item's latest value into **green**, **yellow**, or **red**, and render one aggregated traffic-light result using an MVP **worst-state-wins** rule.\n\nThe widget must integrate with existing dashboard widget add/edit, persistence, rendering, permission, and refresh flows. It must use standard widget validation and cover/error states for invalid configuration, empty item selection, permission loss, unsupported items, and no data.\n\nFor MVP, support numeric items only: **float** and **unsigned integer**, unless existing widget infrastructure requires a narrower supported set.\n\n### Explicit MVP semantics\n- **Aggregation mode:** fixed to `worst-state-wins`.\n- **Threshold model:** one shared threshold configuration applied to all selected items.\n- **Direction:** make threshold direction explicit in implementation.   "description": "## Goal\nImplement a new PHP web UI dashboard widget under `ui/widgets/` that lets a user select one or more supported numeric items, configure shared yellow and red thresholds, evaluate each selected item's latest value using fixed MVP `higher_is_worse` semantics, and render one aggregated traffic-light result.\n\nMVP behavior is fixed:\n- **Aggregation mode:** `worst-state-wins`\n- **Threshold direction:** `higher_is_worse`\n- **Boundary behavior:** inclusive comparisons\n- **Supported items:** numeric items only, specifically float and unsigned integer, unless an existing reusable framework constraint requires a narrower supported subset that is explicitly documented in implementation notes\n\nPer-item evaluation for `higher_is_worse`:\n- `value >= red_threshold` => **red**\n- else `value >= yellow_threshold` => **yellow**\n- else => **green**\n\nAggregation over evaluable items:\n- any red => widget red\n- else any yellow => widget yellow\n- else all green => widget green\n\nThe widget must integrate with existing dashboard add/edit, persistence, rendering, permission, and refresh flows. It must use **standard widget covers** instead of aggregate output for invalid configuration, empty selection, permission loss/inaccessible items, unsupported items, and no-data conditions.\n\n## Scope\nIn scope:\n- Add one new dashboard widget type in the existing PHP UI widget framework under `ui/widgets/<new_widget_id>/`.\n- Register the widget so it appears in the dashboard widget picker and works with standard add/edit/save/load flows.\n- Add widget configuration for:\n  - widget title/name\n  - selection of one or more items\n  - shared yellow threshold\n  - shared red threshold\n  - explicit direction field/value constrained to MVP `higher_is_worse`\n- Persist and restore widget configuration through normal dashboard widget serialization/storage.\n- Perform server-side validation for item selection, threshold parsing, and threshold ordering.\n- Retrieve latest values for selected items during normal widget rendering/refresh using existing item and permission-aware APIs.\n- Evaluate selected items, reduce them with fixed `worst-state-wins` logic, and render a single aggregate state.\n- Use standard widget covers with deterministic precedence for invalid configuration, empty selection, inaccessible items, unsupported items, and no-data cases.\n- Reuse existing field classes, selectors, covers, styling, and rendering conventions where possible.\n\nOut of scope for MVP:\n- User-selectable aggregation modes\n- Per-item thresholds\n- Support for non-numeric items\n- Custom polling or refresh behavior outside standard dashboard refresh\n- New generic selector framework work unless minimally required for this widget\n- Detailed per-item breakdown in widget output\n\nSystem boundaries / changed surfaces:\n- New widget package and manifest under `ui/widgets/`\n- Dashboard widget discovery/picker integration\n- Widget add/edit form and server-side validation\n- Dashboard widget persistence / restoration\n- Render-time item resolution and latest-value lookup\n- Widget template/CSS-class usage for aggregated traffic-light rendering\n- Automated test coverage for validation, rendering, persistence, permissions, and covers\n\n## System Changes\n- Add a new widget package in `ui/widgets/<new_widget_id>/` with manifest, widget action/controller class, and view templates aligned to existing dashboard widget framework patterns.\n- Register the widget so it is discoverable by the dashboard widget picker and participates in standard save/load/render flows.\n- Define widget configuration schema for title, item IDs, yellow threshold, red threshold, and explicit direction value persisted as `higher_is_worse`.\n- Implement form field definitions using existing widget field classes where possible, including a reusable multi-item selector.\n- Restrict or validate selected items to supported numeric item value types only. If selector-level restriction is not fully reusable, enforce support checks server-side without expanding scope into a broad selector refactor.\n- Implement server-side validation that:\n  - at least one item is selected\n  - thresholds are present and numeric\n  - `red_threshold >= yellow_threshold`\n  - saved direction is accepted only as MVP `higher_is_worse`\n- Fetch latest values for selected items during widget rendering using existing APIs that already respect user permissions.\n- Implement render-time decision flow:\n  1. validate config\n  2. ensure non-empty selection\n  3. resolve selected items with permissions\n  4. detect inaccessible items\n  5. validate/filter supported item types\n  6. fetch latest values\n  7. retain evaluable items only\n  8. show no-data cover if none remain\n  9. classify evaluable items\n  10. aggregate with worst-state-wins\n  11. render compact traffic-light output\n- Use standard widget cover handling rather than custom fallback output, with deterministic precedence aligned to existing widget behavior.\n- Return minimal render data needed by the template; avoid exposing unnecessary per-item detail if the widget is intended to show only a single aggregate result.\n- Reuse existing localization patterns for labels, descriptions, validation errors, and cover text.\n\n## Acceptance Criteria\n- A new aggregated item health widget appears in the dashboard widget picker and can be added through the standard add-widget flow.\n- The widget configuration supports:\n  - title/name\n  - selection of one or more items\n  - yellow threshold\n  - red threshold\n  - explicit persisted direction semantics fixed to `higher_is_worse`\n- Saving and reloading a dashboard preserves the widget configuration unchanged.\n- When selected items are supported numeric items with latest values, each item is evaluated with inclusive `higher_is_worse` rules:\n  - `>= red` => red\n  - else `>= yellow` => yellow\n  - else green\n- Aggregation uses fixed `worst-state-wins` behavior:\n  - any red => widget red\n  - else any yellow => widget yellow\n  - else widget green\n- The widget participates in normal dashboard refresh behavior and updates when latest item values change.\n- The widget respects existing permissions and does not expose data for inaccessible items.\n- The widget shows a **standard widget cover** instead of aggregate output when any of the following conditions apply, using deterministic precedence:\n  1. invalid configuration\n  2. empty selection\n  3. inaccessible / no-permission items among the saved selection\n  4. unsupported selected items\n  5. no latest data / zero evaluable items after resolution\n- Inclusive boundary behavior is correct:\n  - value equal to yellow threshold evaluates to yellow\n  - value equal to red threshold evaluates to red\n\n## Implementation Checklist\n### Backend\n- [ ] Create new widget package under `ui/widgets/<new_widget_id>/` following existing widget structure.\n- [ ] Add
